decks.notes: This deck aims to use a combination of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Indomitable Creativity, and Leyline Binding to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield early. The deck focuses on using creative ways to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. By using a diverse range of spells and land cards, the deck can control the game while setting up explosive combo plays to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly playing out cheap artifacts to generate mana and card advantage, while disrupting the opponent with cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza, Lord High Artificer. Utilizing cards like Portable Hole and Urza's Saga, the deck is able to efficiently control the board and put pressure with its aggressive creatures. The inclusion of Urza, Lord High Artificer allows for explosive turns and the ability to quickly close out games. The deck's synergy and speed make it a fast and powerful Aggro - Affinity archetype in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on cycling through its creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with disruption spells like Force of Negation. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures and then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden burst of power. The deck combines control and aggression, utilizing cards like Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand while putting pressure on them with large creatures like Colossal Skyturtle and Striped Riverwinder. The deck aims to win the game through explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with its graveyard recursion strategy.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the board through counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures like Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to control the pace of the game by utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler. Leyline Binding and Solitude provide additional protection while cards like Force of Negation and Supreme Verdict help deal with threats efficiently. The mana base is optimized to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for spells, making the deck a formidable opponent in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on establishing control through a mix of removal, counterspells, and card advantage. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and value. The deck also utilizes a toolbox approach with cards like Traverse the Ulvenwald to find specific answers when needed. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements and ensure consistent access to its powerful spells.

This deck utilizes creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield or death-trigger abilities alongside tutoring spells like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to assemble powerful combos and overwhelm the opponent. The creatures in the deck can be tutored for and played at instant speed, allowing for flexibility and surprise plays. The deck also has some land disruption elements with cards like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Endurance to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The goal is to generate incremental value and drain the opponent's life total with Blood Artist and Zulaport Cutthroat triggers while controlling the battlefield with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa, Ragavan, and Seasoned Pyromancer to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Grief and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and remove threats. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Fury and Terminate to deal with opposing creatures, while also utilizing cards like Undying Evil and Feign Death to generate value from sacrificing creatures. The inclusion of cards like Malakir Rebirth and Undying Malice provides additional ways to protect key creatures and maintain board presence.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Fury, while also having some resilience with cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Malakir Rebirth. Additionally, the deck can surprise the opponent with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Undying Malice to close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through various spells and abilities while utilizing Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal, and card advantage engines like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. The deck also includes powerful threats like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Omnath, Locus of Creation to close out the game. By combining control elements with versatile threats and card advantage, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver its opponents in a long game.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful lands and creatures. It utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to combo off and generate massive amounts of mana and lands. The key strategy is to efficiently play and utilize lands such as Urza's Saga, Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, and Cavern of Souls to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and win the game quickly. The deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and overpower the opponent before they can respond effectively.

This deck revolves around the strategy of utilizing cards like Underworld Breach, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo. By repeatedly casting spells from the graveyard, the deck aims to generate card advantage and quickly mill the opponent's library. It also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's overall goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to either win the game through milling the opponent or by utilizing Thassa's Oracle in combination with the milling strategy.

This deck revolves around assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to create a powerful threat early in the game. The deck also includes support cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Sigarda's Aid to efficiently tutor and equip the Hammer. Esper Sentinel and Shadowspear provide disruption and evasion, while Urza's Saga helps to find key pieces. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy that can quickly close out the game.

This Modern Merfolk deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost Merfolk creatures and using lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident to boost their power and toughness. Key cards like Cursecatcher and Merfolk Trickster provide disruption and tempo advantage, while Aether Vial allows for cheating out creatures at instant speed. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive tempo strategy, supported by lands like Mutavault and Cavern of Souls to ensure smooth mana generation.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It also incorporates disruptive cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The addition of Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion provides a powerful alternate win condition. The deck is also built around a strong mana base with cards like Blood Moon and efficient lands to support the aggressive strategy. Overall, the deck looks to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive threats like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counters like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help dig through the deck quickly to find answers or more threats. The combination of efficient creatures and versatile spells allows the deck to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan effectively in the early to mid game. With a mix of card advantage and powerful threats, this deck aims to close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling the "UrzaTron" lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to quickly ramp up mana and cast powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It utilizes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Karn Liberated to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes various color-fixing cards like Relic of Progenitus and Chromatic Sphere to ensure it can consistently cast its spells. Overall, the key strategy is to quickly ramp up mana, control the game, and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.
